headline: Rays aren’t getting it done
methodology: RISP means at-bats with runners in scoring position; walks and other non-at-bat plate appearances are not included.
Regular season: 380 hits divided by 1,341 at-bats = 28.337...%, rounded to 28.3%. World Series: 3 hits divided by 20 at-bats = 15%.
World Series totals are frozen through Game 2, completed October 24, 2026; the official team split lists two games. These are World Series totals, not all-postseason totals.
